item.title: [github_trending] msitarzewski/agency-agents
item.description: agency-agents is a collection of specialized AI personas — frontend wizards, Reddit community ninjas, whimsy injectors, reality checkers — each with defined processes and deliverables. A new native app for macOS, Linux, and Windows lets you browse the roster and install agents directly into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Osaurus, and more. It gives developers a quick way to wire multiple expert roles into their workflow.

item.title: [github_trending] calesthio/OpenMontage
item.description: OpenMontage bills itself as the first open-source, agentic video production system, with 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, and 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. It aims to turn an AI coding assistant into a full video production pipeline, and the repo includes example prompts plus provider guides. Developers interested in agent-driven media generation can use it as a concrete reference implementation.
